payload.text: Members of the jury, the Crown will present the approved account of Fictional Mira. In E-001, Mira states: "I saw Fictional Rowan hand the sealed envelope to Fictional Ellis. I do not know what the envelope contained." The Crown bears the burden of proving beyond a reasonable doubt that Fictional Ellis received the sealed envelope from Fictional Rowan; no further elements are supplied. E-001 may be used only to attribute Mira's account; it does not prove contents, knowing participation, or guilt.

payload.ground: Defence objects to the pending direct question to witness w1: 'Which cash did Ellis knowingly receive in the sealed envelope?' The question assumes both cash contents and knowing receipt. Per E-001, Mira states: 'I do not know what the envelope contained.' The pinned fictional condition supplies no knowing-participation element. The question asks w1 to confirm premises absent from the approved account and outside the supplied condition. Neutral questions about the handover or observed facts remain permitted. We ask the Court to sustain the objection and strike only this question.
